text.text: Condensed was a huge help in bringing my website to life. Early in the process they helped me zero in on what my brand identity is and isn’t, which made every later decision easier. From there, they were patient, understanding, and consistently cooperative while I took…longer than optimal (!!)…to settle on my aesthetic and content vision. They never made that feel stressful - they just stayed steady and constructive the whole way. They also guided me to a template and build approach that works extremely well across devices (desktop, tablet, mobile), whereas some of the "AI website" options out there I contemplated originally would have used a site that looked fine in one context but fell apart in real-world viewing, a trap Condensed help me avoid. Finally, the end product is genuinely aesthetically beautiful and exactly the level of “polished” I was hoping for. If you want someone who can deliver a great-looking site and keep you grounded through the messy, iterative process of figuring out your message and vibe, I recommend Condensed!

The Philipstown Depot Theater hired Condensed to redesign our website and help us refine our branding. This wasn't just a look-and-feel upgrade; they completely reorganized the way the theater presents itself to the world and interacts with artists and audience members. It was a resounding success, with board members, performers, funders, staff, and ticket-buyers all cheering the result. Along the way, Condensed helped us identify and articulate what makes the Depot Theater special, what sets it apart from other performing arts venues, something we hadn't done in far too long. They managed all that on a tight timeline and on a budget a small, non-profit theater could afford. Brent & Teresa and their team are all aces, top-shelf through and through. We're glad to have worked with them and looking forward to further collaborations.
(Ned Rauch, Marketing Director, Philipstown Depot Theater, Garrison, NY)
